Description: As a customer, I want to browse restaurants so that I can choose where to order from. Acceptance criteria: Given restaurants are available, when I open the app, then I see names and details. When none are available, then I see an empty-state message.

As a customer, I want to view a restaurant's menu so that I can select food items. Acceptance criteria: Given I select a restaurant, when its menu loads, then I see item names and prices. Unavailable items cannot be added.
As a customer, I want to add and remove menu items so that I can manage my order. Acceptance criteria: Adding an item updates its quantity; removing an item updates the cart and total.
As a customer, I want to review my cart total so that I know the cost before checkout. Acceptance criteria: Cart shows items, quantities, prices, and total. An empty cart cannot be checked out.

As a customer, I want to enter delivery details and place an order so that food can be delivered. Acceptance criteria: Valid name and address plus a non-empty cart produce an order confirmation; invalid fields show validation errors.
As a customer, I want to view order status so that I know its progress. Acceptance criteria: A placed order displays a status such as Confirmed, Preparing, or Out for Delivery.
As restaurant staff, I want to update order status so that the customer sees current progress. Acceptance criteria: Staff can save a status change and the customer can see the updated status.
As a customer, I want to filter restaurants by cuisine so that I can find food I like faster. Acceptance criteria: Selecting a cuisine displays matching restaurants only.
